g.text: Turn 7 - arrival, Happy Hour, seating, order, first cooking unit
reason shown, task not used up,
a VIP orders during Happy Hour and is followed from arrival to payment, then the result check.
Starting conditions (start of turn 7, run stage3-victory):
C1 has paid ($9.00); Critic C2 is eating at Table 2; Table 1 is free;
Happy Hour has not been used. VIP C3 arrives this turn.
Manager choice that changes the outcome:
switching Happy Hour on in turn 7 locks C3's bill at $12.96 instead of $16.20,
and C3 recovers 95 -> 100 at the start of turn 8. Steps of turns 7-11 that involve other customers are left out.
C3 pays $12.96 in turn 11 with satisfaction 95. After turn 18: 5 paid, $85.86, average 86.6 -> VICTORY.
